correctness.rationale: With N≥7, alpha=pi/N and 0<theta<alpha, explicit positive Feres branches give a connected N-state graph with one N−2 cycle and two leaves, sine detailed balance, period gcd(2,N−2). For each k≠0, twisted K_k(v,w)=P(v,w)e^{2ikw} has spectral radius ≤1; equality would enforce a common loop eigenphase. Two loops A1→A0→A1 and A1→B1→A1 give e^{4ik(theta−alpha)}=1, impossible for irrational theta/pi. Hence each spatial mode contracts and Fourier approximation yields weak Haar spatial convergence with parity-conditioned angular limit. Rational theta/pi traps positions in finite circle subgroup, precluding Haar. Independently built N=7–10 matrices show sine reversibility and all tested 1≤k≤4 radii<1; these are finite checks only.
